title: Golf Apparel Brand TravisMathew Teams Up with Peloton for Exclusive New Collection - NewsBreak
text: The best golfers know that the work doesn't end when the final putt falls on the 18th hole. Between rounds there are hours of training to be done both on and off the course, and the world's best golfers place an emphasis on health and fitness just as much as they do on their short game. Enter the latest collaboration between beloved golf apparel and lifestyle brand, TravisMathew, and Peloton. Designed as off-course wear for workouts or comfortable outfits for running errands, the TravisMathew x Peloton collaboration seamlessly blends design and function. The upcoming collection features women's tees, tops and dresses as well as shorts and leggings in a bold, bright color palette that's perfect for summer. The collaboration also includes pullovers and a retro-inspired bomber jacket for chilly mornings or late-night sweat sessions. The official description says the TravisMathew x Peloton collaboration is designed "for the moments that move you, the rhythm of real life — before the workout, after the cooldown and everywhere in between." Charles LeClaire-Imagn Images TravisMathew is worn by U.S. Ryder Cup Captain, Keegan Bradley , who has been rocking the brand since 2017, both on and off the course. Five-time PGA Tour winner Sam Burns also sports the brand frequently during tournament play. This isn't the first collaboration between the two fan-favorite brands. TravisMathew and Peloton have teamed up in the past on a limited-edition men's line that featured polos and pullovers. The TravisMathew x Peloton collection will be available at both Peloton Apparel and TravisMathew starting July 10, 2025. The new collaboration features women's apparel exclusively, but if the drop is a success, it's possible they'll introduce a men's line of athletic apparel later on.
